title: Cover Drive Front Foot (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, the cover drive
The most BEAUTIFUL shot in cricket
When it is done right, even the fielders applaud

[Verse 1]
Ball pitches on a good length, just outside off
Front foot forward, head over the ball
Bat comes down from high to low, late wrists
Cover drive through the gap, the crowd insists

Weight transferred to the front foot firm
Head down, eyes level, watch the ball affirm
The bat face stays open toward cover point
Follow through high, that is the whole joint

[Pre-Chorus]
Head over ball, front foot plants down
Bat comes late, follow through to crown
Cover drive, the shot of the great
Head over ball and follow through straight

[Chorus]
Cover drive front foot, head over ball
Bat comes late and follow-through tall
Through the gap to the cover boundary
Cover drive, that is pure cricketing glory

[Verse 2]
Dont plant too early, ball reads your weight
Stay patient, stay side-on, let it come late
The secret is the bat angle at impact, open
Slightly toward cover, and the boundary is spoken

[Bridge]
Bluey: AND HE HAS DRIVEN IT THROUGH COVER, TEXTBOOK STROKE PLAY
Trevor: Excellent weight transfer, head position was perfect throughout the shot
Chas: That is what I say, head over the ball, bat comes late, every morning in the nets

[Chorus]
Cover drive front foot, head over ball
Bat comes late and follow-through tall
Through the gap to the cover boundary
Cover drive, that is pure cricketing glory

[Outro]
Head over ball son
Every time
Thats my boy
